summary: 社会史把研究焦点转向寻常生活，以及过去常被忽视的人群。文章追溯这一研究在二十世纪六七十年代兴起的背景，也质疑研究者对往昔的怀旧和对“普通人”的笼统想象。
logic: 比较传统史与社会史的对象
追踪文化潮流和遗产保护
审视怀旧与共情的限度

paragraphs.brief: 学术晋升如何影响历史选题
sentences: Ever since its elevation to the status of an academic discipline, history has been very largely concerned with problems of its own making.
自历史学取得独立学科地位以来，它所关注的往往是学科内部自己提出的研究问题。
These may be gaps which the young researcher is advised by supervisors to fill; or established views which he or she is encouraged to challenge.
有时是导师建议青年学者填补的研究空白，有时是导师鼓励他们挑战的现成观点。
In either case, the need for the researcher to provide new insights in order to gain professional advancement often counts for more than the intrinsic interest of the topic.
无论是哪一种情形，研究者为职业晋升而提出新见解的需要，往往比题目本身是否有趣更有分量。
paragraphs.gist: 成为学术学科后，历史研究常以填补空白或挑战旧说为题，而推动研究者选题的往往是职业发展所需的新见，而非问题本身的吸引力。

paragraphs.brief: 社会史转向日常生活和公共议题
sentences: Social history is quite different.
社会历史是完全不同的。
It touches on, and arguably helps to focus, major issues of public debate.
它涉及而且可以说有助于突出公众辩论的主要问题。
It mobilises popular enthusiasm and engages popular passions.
社会史能调动公众的热情，也能回应他们真正关心的事情。

It prides itself on being concerned with everyday things rather than sensational events and is directed against the ‘Great Man’ theories that originally characterised history, and the tedious focus on bureaucratic issues that subsequently dominated the 1920s and 30s.
社会史以关注日常生活为傲，对早期史学崇尚的“伟人史观”和后来主导二三十年代的枯燥官僚制度研究都提出了挑战。
This is also reflected in the way it is taught, through the adoption of multi-disciplinary perspectives rather than a narrow historical interpretation.
这还反映在教学方式上，采用多学科的观点，而不是狭隘的历史解释。
paragraphs.gist: 社会史关注日常生活和公众争论，反对唯伟人和行政事务的历史叙事，在教学中也更愿借用多个学科的视角。

paragraphs.brief: 文化变革与研究年代的推移
sentences: Social history emerged, both as a popular enthusiasm and as a scholarly practice, from the cultural revolution of the 1960s in North America and Europe, and reproduces its leading inspirations.
北美和欧洲二十世纪六十年代的文化变革，既让社会史成为大众的兴趣，也使它发展为学术实践；这门学科也反映着那场变革的主要思想。
The spirit of social history was pre-eminently a modernising one, as reflected in its choice of subject matter.
社会历史的精神是现代化的精神，这反映在对主题的选择上。
Whereas traditional history had focused on the 12th to 17th centuries, social history was apt to make its historical homeland in the 19th century.
传统史学关注十二至十七世纪，社会史则更倾向于把十九世纪作为主要研究时期。
Latterly, it has even begun to extend its inquiry up to contemporary events and movements.
后来，它甚至开始将调查范围扩大到当代事件和运动。
paragraphs.gist: 社会史在二十世纪六十年代欧美文化变革中兴起，关注的时代也从传统史学重视的十二至十七世纪转向十九世纪，后来延至当代。

paragraphs.brief: 普通人的历史呼应反权威文化
sentences: The subject matter favoured by the new social history, with its move away from the aristocracy and the establishment, corresponds to other cultural manifestations of the 1960s, such as New Wave British cinema, with its working-class protagonists, or ‘Pop art’, with its use of everyday artefacts.
新社会史将目光从贵族和权势阶层移开，这与六十年代的其他文化现象相呼应，例如英国新浪潮电影把工人阶级写成主角，波普艺术则使用日常物品。

Similarly, the anti-institutional bias of the new social history—the renewed determination to write the history of ‘ordinary’ people as against that of statecraft—could be said to echo a much more widespread collapse of social deference, and a questioning of authority figures of all kinds.
新社会史决意把普通人的经历写进历史，摆脱只写治国方略的传统，这种反体制倾向也呼应了社会对尊卑秩序的动摇和对种种权威的质疑。
paragraphs.gist: 社会史书写普通人而淡化上层政治，呼应了新浪潮电影、波普艺术对工人和日用品的兴趣，也映照出社会对权威的普遍质疑。

paragraphs.brief: 怀旧产业与对战后变迁的失望
sentences: Another major 1960s influence on the new social history—very different in its origins and effects—was the ‘nostalgia industry’, which focused on the sale of memorabilia and artefacts from recent history.
1960年代对新社会历史的另一个主要影响——其起源和影响大不相同——是 " 怀旧业 "，它侧重于销售近代历史的纪念品和文物。

This emerged as a kind of negative counterpart to the otherwise dominant modernisation of the decade and reflected a disenchantment, no less apparent on the Left of the political spectrum than on the Right, with post-war social change.
这股潮流与那个年代占主导的现代化倾向形成反差，反映了对战后社会变革的失望，而这种情绪在政治左翼和右翼同样明显。
paragraphs.gist: 出售近代纪念品的怀旧产业同样影响了社会史，它与当时的现代化热潮形成反差，也表明左右两派都对战后社会变化有所失望。

paragraphs.brief: 工业遗产和民歌重估劳动价值
sentences: Industrial archaeology, an invention of the 1960s, elevated disused factories and mills to the status of national monuments.
工业考古学是1960年代的发明，将废弃的工厂和磨坊提升为国家古迹。
Following in the same track, property restorers turned houses built for 19th-century factory workers—once emblems of poverty, overcrowding, and ill-health—into picturesque residences.
沿着相同思路，房屋修复者将十九世纪专为工厂工人建造、曾象征贫困拥挤与疾病的住宅，改成了风景如画的居所。
In another sphere, one could point to the proliferation of folk clubs and the discovery of industrial folk songs, prefiguring one of the major themes of the new social history—the dignity of labour.
在另一个领域，人们可以指出民间俱乐部的扩散和工业民间歌曲的发现，预示了新社会史的一个主要主题——劳动尊严。
paragraphs.gist: 废弃工厂被列为遗迹，昔日工人住房得以修复，工业民歌也被重新发掘，共同预示了新社会史对劳动尊严的关注。

paragraphs.brief: 找回消失社区与普通人的尊严
sentences: So far as historical work was concerned, by the 1970s the sense of disenchantment had crystallised into an idealised view of the past, fostering a nostalgic regard for disappearing communities.
就历史工作而言，到1970年代，幻灭感已形成对过去的理想看法，促使人们怀念消失的社区。
The restoration of vanished components of ‘the world we have lost’ became a major impetus in historical writing and research.
恢复“我们失去的世界”中消失的部分，成为历史著作和研究的一大动力。

The dignity of ordinary people could be said to be the unifying theme of this line of historical inquiry and retrieval—a celebration of everyday life, even, perhaps especially, when it involved hardship and suffering.
寻回往日生活的研究以普通人的尊严为共同主题，它是对日常生活的礼赞，甚至尤其重视其中的艰辛和苦楚。
paragraphs.gist: 到七十年代，重建消失的社区和生活方式成了写史动力，歌颂普通人在困苦中保持的尊严也成为这些研究的共同主题。

paragraphs.brief: 堆积生活细节不能代替历史解释
sentences: Despite the novelty of its subject matter, social history reproduces many of the characteristic biases of its predecessors.
尽管它的主题内容很新颖，但社会历史却重复了它前身的许多典型偏见。

Social historians are good at amassing details on household artefacts, budgets, daily purchases, but at times the evidence is assumed to speak for itself, and the simple reproduction of fact masquerades as explanation.
社会史学家善于搜集家用品、家庭预算和日常购物等细节，但有时他们以为证据会自己说话，把简单罗列事实当成了解释。
The facts accumulated may leave no conceptual space for the great absences, for the many areas where the documentary record is silent.
层层堆积的事实，可能让人想不到那些重大缺失，以及文献全无记载的领域。
paragraphs.gist: 社会史虽更换了题材，却可能重演旧偏见，把家庭用品、开支等细节的堆积当成解释，从而忽略档案沉默之处留下的问题。

paragraphs.brief: 与过去共情也可能妨碍反思
sentences: The indulgence which social historians extend towards their subjects, and the desire to establish ‘empathy’—seeing the past in terms of its own values rather than those of today— can also serve to flatter our self-esteem, making history a field in which, at no great cost to ourselves, we can demonstrate our enlarged sympathies and benevolence.
社会史学家宽厚看待研究对象，希望以当时的价值观理解过去、与古人共情；但这种做法也可能满足我们自我欣赏的愿望，让我们不用付出什么代价就能展示自己的同情与善意。

Recognising our kinship to people in the past, and tracing, or discovering, their likeness to ourselves, we are flattered in the belief that underneath we are all lovable; eccentric perhaps and even absurd, but large-hearted, generous and frank.
我们在古人身上认出与自己的相似之处，便容易满足于这样一种想象：大家本质上都很可爱，也许古怪，甚至荒唐，却都宽厚、慷慨而坦率。

This sense of integration with the past can thus serve as a comfortable alternative to critical awareness and self-questioning, allowing us to dignify the present by illegitimate association with the past.
这样，与过去融为一体的感觉就可能成为舒适的替代品，让我们不再批判反思，而凭借与过去并不成立的联系来美化当下。
paragraphs.gist: 对过去的人抱有共情，也可能只是用彼此相似来肯定当代人的善意，令舒适的认同感取代对过去与现在的批判性反思。

paragraphs.brief: 恐惧和冲突也应进入社会史
sentences: Social history, if it is to fulfil its subversive potential, needs to be a great deal more disturbing.
社会历史如果要发挥其颠覆潜力，就必须更加令人不安。

If it is to celebrate a common humanity, and to bring past and present closer together, far more weight needs to be given to the effects of insecurities and emergencies—the fears that shadow the growing up of children, the oppositions we encounter during our lives—experiences which may be hard for an individual to categorise but which nevertheless have a significance which goes beyond that individual.
要展现共同的人性、拉近过去与现在，就必须更重视不安与危机的影响，例如笼罩童年的恐惧或一生中遇到的冲突；这些经历个人也许难以归类，意义却不限于个人。
paragraphs.gist: 作者认为，社会史若要真正挑战旧看法，就要重视人们成长中遭遇的恐惧、危机和冲突，探究这些难以归类的经历为何超出个人层面。

paragraphs.brief: 反思“普通人”这一历史标签
sentences: Perhaps too we might recognise that there is a profound condescension in the notion of ‘ordinary people’—that unified totality in which social historians are apt to deal.
或许也应承认，社会史学家往往把“普通人”当成一个整体来处理，而这种说法本身就暗含很深的居高临下。
Implicitly it is a category from which we tend to exclude ourselves, although in fact we are exceptional only by our privilege of hindsight.
我们往往不自觉地把自己排除在“普通人”之外，其实我们唯一的特殊之处只是拥有事后回望的便利。
‘There are … no masses,’ Raymond Williams wrote, ‘only ways of seeing people as masses.’
雷蒙德·威廉姆斯写道："没有群众，只有把人们看成大众的方式"。
It is perhaps time for historians to scrutinise the term ‘ordinary people’ in the same way.
或许历史学家应该以同样的方式仔细研究 " 普通人 " 一词。
paragraphs.gist: 把前人统称为“普通人”可能暗含优越姿态，因为研究者容易把自己排除在这个标签之外，真正的差别往往只是他们享有后见之明。

groups.label: 选词填空
groups.instructionsZh: 阅读带空格的中译，回想正确词项及其字母。

items.en: The rise of social history led to the cultural revolution of the 1960s.
items.zh: 社会历史的兴起导致了1960年代的文化革命。
items.why: 原文是“社会史出自于60 年代文化革命",非“导致/1引发”。与题干因果相反 = NO。

items.en: Social historians tend to study a later period of history than traditional historians did.
items.zh: 与传统史学家相比，社会史学家倾向于研究较晚的历史时期。
items.why: 清晰对比: 传统12-17世纪 vs 社会史偏 19 世纪并延至当代 = YES.

items.en: British cinema in the 1960s lacked any working-class characters.
items.zh: 二十世纪六十年代的英国电影中没有工人阶级角色。
items.why: 原文明确“工人阶级的主角”存在，题干说“没有”,与原文相反 = NO。

items.en: The loss of respect for authority in the 1960s was a leading cause of social problems.
items.zh: 1960年代丧失对权威的尊重是社会问题的一个主要原因。
items.why: 对传统权威的质疑被用来解释新社会史的研究取向。作者没有把这种变化列为当时社会问题的主要原因。

groups.label: 观点判断 · YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

items.en: What point is made about the ‘nostalgia industry’?
items.zh: 作者对“怀旧产业”提出了什么看法？
correct: It opposed the dominant trend of the time.
它反对当时的主导趋势。

items.en: In the sixth paragraph, the writer makes the point that in the 1960s
items.zh: 在第六段中，作者指出，1960年代
correct: there was a new interest in traditional industrial buildings.
对传统的工业建筑有了新的兴趣。

items.en: By the 1970s, historians had come to believe that
items.zh: 到1970年代，历史学家们开始相信
correct: modern life is not necessarily an improvement on the past.
现代生活不一定比过去有所改进。

items.en: One problem related to the use of detail by social historians is that
items.zh: 与社会历史学家使用细节有关的一个问题是：
correct: more important issues may be ignored.
更重要的问题可能被忽视。

items.en: The writer recommends that to be effective, social history must
items.zh: 作者建议，要有效，社会历史必须
correct: explore the negative emotions that are part of daily life.
探索作为日常生活一部分的负面情绪。

points: 原文明确“工人阶级的主角”存在，题干说“没有”,与原文相反 = NO。

clauses: These may be gaps … ; or established views which he or she is encouraged to challenge.
“which the young researcher is advised by supervisors to fill”修饰前面的 gaps。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 which 时，回看 gaps，再把修饰信息接回主句。

Recognising our kinship to people in the past, and tracing, or discovering, their likeness to ourselves, we are flattered in the belief … ; eccentric perhaps and even absurd, but large-hearted, generous and frank.
“that underneath we are all lovable”补足 flattered 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 flattered 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
